name: EPIC 206555394
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 12.1 solar radii and 1.12 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206555394 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.090004 (16th-84th percentiles 11.4224-12.819752), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,680 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.12 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,669 K at its surface.
